items.effect: kept: the chart, its workbook and its style parts are stored unchanged and saved back; the editor shows a labelled placeholder and cannot edit or draw it
items.label: chart(s)

items.effect: approximated: flattened, the placeholder keeps the position and size it inherits as its own
items.label: placeholder(s) that take their position from the layout (flattened on import)

items.effect: approximated: its text styles are the base of the notes text; the notes page layout (slide image, header, footer, date, page number placeholders and the master's own theme) is not kept
items.label: notes master(s)

items.effect: kept: the deck keeps its own slide size
items.label: slide size other than 16:9

items.effect: approximated: the banding is resolved into each cell's fill and the switch is kept
items.label: table(s) with banded rows or columns

items.effect: kept: spans are stored on the origin cell and the cells it covers are marked
items.label: merged table cell(s)

items.effect: approximated: the style is resolved into each cell (fill, borders, bold, colour) and its name kept; corner-cell rules are not applied, and a built-in style the file does not define is not resolved
items.label: table(s) with a table style

items.effect: approximated: the stored font scale and line spacing reduction are applied as written; line breaks may differ from PowerPoint
items.label: text box(es) that shrink or resize to fit their text

items.effect: lost: not imported (the PPTX reader does not read this yet)
items.label: theme effect scheme(s) with shadows, glow or reflection
